summary: Comprehensive testing of Moto Import platform completed. All major features working correctly: Login, Registration (Dealer & Supplier), Admin Dashboard, Dealer Dashboard, Language switching (NL/DE/FR/IT), PDF handleidingen, Push Notification toggle, Order dialog with keuring/taxatie options, Pakbon page, Terms Modal.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 404 - pakbon data is fetched from /api/orders instead (frontend-only implementation)

issues: Brief error toast 'Kon bestellingen niet laden' appears even when orders load successfully - likely race condition with push notifications API

passed_tests: Login page loads correctly with all form elements
Login page shows handleiding links (dealer & supplier PDF)
Dealer registration page loads with all form fields
Supplier registration page (/register/supplier) loads with country selector
Admin dashboard - dealer management page loads
Language switching works on login page (NL/DE/FR/IT)
Language switching works on dealer guide page
Push notification toggle component visible on dealer dashboard
Order dialog shows taxatie option (€160 excl. BTW)
Order dialog shows voucher code input
Pakbon page loads correctly after login
Terms Modal (Algemene Voorwaarden) appears for new dealers
Backend API: Admin login returns token and user data
Backend API: Dealer login returns token with is_approved field
critical_code_review_comments: All pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Language switching is well implemented with i18next
Order dialog properly calculates total with all options (delivery, keuring, taxatie, voucher)
PDF files are properly served from /app/frontend/public/guides/
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major features tested and working. The platform supports 4 languages (NL/DE/FR/IT). Order dialog has keuring (€125) and taxatie (€160) options. PDF handleidingen are in /app/frontend/public/guides/. Push notifications use service worker v2.
